      "contract_id": "grover-predicate-v0",
      "applicable": false,
      "rationale": "No finite black-box predicate or unknown marked state; each output is directly computed from left/right as XOR and must be returned exactly for every record in order, so Grover-style search is structurally inapplicable."

      "contract_id": "qubo-ising-v0",
      "applicable": false,
      "rationale": "No binary optimization objective, constraints, or feasible-assignment decoding; the task is an exact deterministic transformation with ordered receipts and checksums, so QUBO/Ising/QAOA is inapplicable."
    }
  ]
}
